description: Two storey side extension and part single, part 2-storey rear extension together with 2x rear dormers with Juliette balconies and front and side rooflights.
decision_conditions: The proposed two storey side and rear extension, including new roof form over by reason of its size, siting, mass and design would appear bulky and incongruous, and would represent an overly dominant, incongruous and visually intrusive form of development, out of keeping and character with, and detrimental to the appearance and character of the property and surrounding area.  This would be contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF, 2021), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), Core Strategy (2010) Policies CP30, Development Management Document (2014) Polices DMD11, DMD13, DMD14 and DMD37.

The proposed two storey side extension by reason of its siting, width, scale and roof form would result in the closing of an important visual gap between buildings and create a continuous façade with the neighbouring detached property having a negative impact on the appearance of the streetscene, spacing and rhythm of the streetscape and give rise to an awkward relationship between buildings.  This would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF, 2021), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), DMD8, DMD13, DMD14 and DMD37 of the Development Management Document (2014) and Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010).

The proposed part two storey, part single storey side and rear extensions including new roof form over by reason of size, siting, mass and depth would have an overbearing effect upon the adjoining property No. 139 Wynchgate,  contrary to Core Strategy (2010) Policy CP30 Development Management Document (2014) Policies DMD8 and DMD14, DMD14 and DMD37.
